Chapter 6847: You Dare To Challenge Me?

Chapter 6847: You Dare To Challenge Me?

The water didn’t sit idly by to die. It tried everything, resulting in an explosion capable of sending everything back to the origin.

“Buzz.” The reversion gave birth to a magnificent entity appearing before the duo - an inscrutable light.

It was the end of time and space, the finality of dao and karma... It had no life or laws but it was everything - the high heaven.

That’s right, this light deep in space was the high heaven looming over all else.

“Bam!” Thunder Emperor dropped down on her knees, unable to control her body. Her dao, true fate, and everything nearly turned into particles to fly toward the source.

The appearance of the high heaven meant a reversion to the beginning. All lives started with the high heaven, so they would return there upon being summoned.

She couldn’t be afraid since her emotions belonged to the high heaven as well. She could only watch as her body became particles.

My fate is my own.

This popular phrase among cultivators no longer applied. Her everything was being taken forcefully.

She could resist an opponent. Her will was strong enough to stand against an immortal. However, the high heaven was a different story.

Bear Immortal fared much better, summoning divine rings for protection. Alas, they were crushed by the pressure.

He then summoned his ancient banner; its tassels draped down around him.

“Primordial Banner!” He roared the name of the artifact left behind by his master, allowing him to block a primordial immortal’s attack.

The source of the attack shook once after a full swing from the banner.

“Imitating the high heaven is useless.” Li Qiye smiled: “You’re already dead so borrowing a heavenly treasure doesn’t change that. Moreover, you couldn’t do anything while you were alive anyway, this is just a joke.”

The high heaven power couldn’t affect Li Qiye, seemingly enraged by his remark.

“Boom!” It sent down an ultimate power like countless suns exploding.

“So strong!” The bear’s expression darkened.

It focused on Li Qiye alone, capable of crushing three thousand worlds all at once.

“You dare to challenge me?” Li Qiye didn’t bother to dodge.

As it smashed into him with the highest force, it couldn’t put a dent. Li Qiye suddenly became ethereal; any spectator would see something different.

For example, Thunder Emperor saw living beings. Although they were weak, they had emotions and were the main characters of their own life.

Emperors might view them as insignificant but in the grand scheme of things, emperors were just as trivial.
